body: From the DM-169 review (orchestrator, this run): `selectBaseline` (src/core/space/baselines.ts) does not parse its subject; parse with `parseBaselineSubject` first, because a non-ISO string that Date.parse accepts (e.g. '9999') is taken at face value. `dispatchedAt` (now required on SpaceGradeInput and SpaceGrade) and every `frozenAt` must come from server lifecycle records, never callers: a later dispatchedAt lets a mid-run budget score K at 100.
